documents.title: Charge command
documents.text: createCharge validates an idempotency key and records a pending payment before capture.

documents.title: Payment ledger
documents.text: The payment ledger is an append-only record of authorization, capture, refund, and settlement events.

documents.title: Payments impact map
documents.text: Changing capture retries affects the charge worker, ledger projections, and merchant notifications.

documents.title: Payments history
documents.text: The June 2025 payments migration introduced idempotent capture retries and retired the synchronous callback.

documents.title: Payments change
documents.text: The latest release stores retry outcomes in the ledger and marks duplicate capture requests as safe no-ops.

documents.title: Payments decision record
documents.text: Decision: idempotency is enforced at the charge boundary and ledger writes remain append-only for recovery.

documents.title: Payments repository overview
documents.text: Beacon Payments is a TypeScript service for idempotent charges, append-only ledger events, and settlement workers.

update.text: createRefund appends a refund event to the payment ledger after authorization.
